# Kiro

Opt-in checks for native Kiro JSON/Markdown agents, literal local references, and workspace/agent MCP field types. Recursive steering and nested project resources also receive shared content and MCP security checks. See [Kiro support](../kiro.md) for CLI 2.x/V3 compatibility and runtime limits.

| Rule ID | Description | Default Severity | Autofix |
|---------|-------------|------------------|---------|
| [`kiro-agent-valid`](kiro-agent-valid.md) | Kiro JSON and Markdown agents must use valid syntax and documented field types | error (disabled) | - |
| [`kiro-mcp-valid`](kiro-mcp-valid.md) | Kiro workspace and agent MCP entries must use documented field types | error (disabled) | - |
| [`kiro-references`](kiro-references.md) | Literal local Kiro prompt, resource, and steering references should exist | warning (disabled) | - |
